Read materialized Compendium I12–15 and newly pinned De ente et essentia capp.3–4 (Baur/Koch Corpus Thomisticum numbering,69874–5). De ente enumerates three multiplication modes, distinguishes addition-excluding pure esse from indeterminate common being, and takes genus/differentia of simple immaterial quiddities from the whole rather than real quiddity-parts. This narrows the live bridge but supplies no independently defended exhaustive exclusion of primitive whole-subject individuation or different whole essences. Rejected unrestricted identity-predicate PII, inferring real composition from predication, common numerical nature from one predicate, and reverse use of the all-other-things-receive-esse conclusion whose source derivation already uses uniqueness. Precise locators, strongest rival and conditional defense boundaries persist in docs/notes/necessary-simple-plurality.md. No new claim/theorem, no added/removed/discharged premise; intended and actual root delta zero. Follow-up: read materialized ST I q.7 aa.1–2 in full. A.1 distinguishes matter perfected by form from form contracted by matter; ad3 distinguishes unreceived from received instances, not two unreceived beings. A.2 co. infers reception/contraction from stated created-form essence/esse nonidentity, not nonidentity from determinate nature. Sed contra uses all-others causal dependence; ad1 uses createdness. Neither supplies an independent exclusion of two uncreated whole essences each identical with esse. The existing note preserves exact within-article locators and rejected converse. #697 constitutive-content test: materialized/read full Compendium I12–15, ST Iq3a3, q11a3 and q4a2. General singular-basis incommunicability is distinct from proper-God suppositum/nature scope; the latter requires an explicit first-mover adapter. Q4a2 obj2/reply1–2 permits opposed forms to preexist eminently as one, so formal essence difference cannot silently supply an absent eminent perfection. New zero-axiom conditional compositions separate complete nature content from SAME-InAct alignment, derive the exact old differentiation premise with explicit EM, and derive at-most-one through imported Q11. The unchanged original PartFreePlurality.JointControl supports independent omissions: old act-content alignment lacks completeness; an injective same-carrier code lacks alignment. Auxiliary positive consistency witness reuses the existing OneFirstMover.Joint carrier/motion/act with explicitly different represented principles/content, not the plural ontology. Rejected arbitrary respect-dictionary padding and unrestricted identity-predicate PII. All three new semantic/domain interfaces remain OPEN and independent warrant is blocked; no source claim or old Challenge changes. Default designated-root report remains63 and every route cost unchanged; differentiation is now displayed as proved resting on open premises, not closed. The existing note records precise projection scope, all assignments, strongest reply and source locators.
